name: Natya Shastra (नाट्यशास्त्र)
author: Bharata Muni
description: The foundational Sanskrit encyclopedic treatise on performing arts, dramaturgy, musicology, and instrument classification (Vadya Vinyasa).

citations.quote: ततं चैवावनद्धं च घनं सुषिरमेव च। चतुर्विधं तु विज्ञेयं वाद्यं लक्षणसंयुतम्॥
citations.translation: Musical instruments are known to be of fourfold classification: Tata (stringed), Avanaddha (percussion/covered), Ghana (solid/idiophones), and Sushira (wind).

name: Sangita Ratnakara (सङ्गीतरत्नाकर)
author: Sharngadeva
description: The definitive medieval musicological text describing 22 Shrutis, Raga taxonomy, and medieval veenas.

citations.translation: The Pinaki has a staff shaped like an archer bow, strung with a single sacred chord.

name: Silappadikaram (சிலப்பதிகாரம்)
author: Ilango Adigal
description: The ancient Sangam Tamil epic chronicling the courtly culture and 14-string silk Yazh harps.

citations.quote: வார் உறு கோலும் வரியுறு நரம்பும் ஏறுபெறத் தொடுத்து...
citations.translation: Plucking the pure silk strings resting upon the curved bow-arm, sweet notes of the Sevvazhi pann echoed.
